id: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
en: \bI guess we can fly you around. Where are we going?
it: \bSuppongo che possiamo portarti in volo. Dove andiamo?

id: \bPaul: So you're finally here. Show me your full strength.
en: \bPaul: So you're finally here. Show me your full strength.
it: \bPaul: Finalmente sei qui. Mostrami tutta la tua forza.

id: \bPaul: That was something. Maybe you'll improve by the Sinnoh League.
en: \bPaul: That was something. Maybe you'll improve by the Sinnoh League.
it: \bPaul: Niente male. Forse migliorerai entro la Lega di Sinnoh.

id: \bYou still have one more badge to get, don't you? Try the Sunnyshore Gym. Get there from Valor Lakefront.
en: \bYou still have one more badge to get, don't you? Try the Sunnyshore Gym. Get there from Valor Lakefront.
it: \bTi manca ancora una Medaglia, vero? Prova la Palestra di Arenipoli. Ci arrivi da Riva Lago Valore.

id: \bI'll be going now. Don't disappoint me next time I see you.
en: \bI'll be going now. Don't disappoint me next time I see you.
it: \bOra me ne vado. Non deludermi la prossima volta che ci vediamo.
